definition_en: a judgement of the value, quality, or performance of a person or thing
core_image: 把东西托在手心掂一掂，再在价签上写下一个数目
scene: 年底述职的时候，主管对照年初定下的目标，逐项给每位员工的工作表现打分。At the end of the year, the manager rates each team member in a formal appraisal.
sceneCN: 这里 appraisal 是「绩效评估」（第 1 个义项：对员工工作表现的正式考核）；句意：年底述职时，主管在一场正式评估中给团队每位成员打分。

derivatives.zh: 由名词 appraisal 去掉后缀 -al 得到的动词，义为「估价；评估」
appraise 加表示施事者的后缀 -er，指「估价师；考核人」
appraising 加 -ly 构成的副词，义为「以审视的目光」

senses.title: A formal review of an employee
senses.definition: a regular, formal judgement of how well an employee has done the job
senses.definitionCN: 对员工工作表现作出的定期正式评判
senses.example: Her appraisal is scheduled for next Tuesday.
senses.exampleCN: 她的绩效评估安排在下周二。
senses.why: An appraisal sets a value on work, so the word naturally names the formal review that rates an employee.
senses.whyCN: appraisal 的本义是给某物定出价值，把它用在人的工作上，就成了给员工表现打分的正式考核。

senses.title: A valuation of property
senses.definition: an estimate of how much a building, a company, or an asset is worth
senses.definitionCN: 对房产、公司或资产价值的估算
senses.example: The bank ordered an appraisal before approving the loan.
senses.exampleCN: 银行在批准贷款之前要求做一次估价。
senses.why: The Latin root pretium means price, so the noun keeps the plain act of putting a price on a thing.
senses.whyCN: 词根 pretium 就是价格，所以这个词保留了给东西定出价钱这一最朴素的动作。

senses.title: A judgement of worth
senses.definition: an opinion about the value or quality of something, formed after looking at it carefully
senses.definitionCN: 仔细审视之后对某事物的价值或品质形成的看法
senses.example: Her appraisal of the novel was sharp and fair.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这部小说的评价犀利而公允。
senses.why: Once a price can be set, any careful judgement of worth can be called an appraisal.
senses.whyCN: 既然能给东西定价，那么任何对价值的审慎判断都可以叫 appraisal，这是从定价扩大到评断。

senses.title: An expert valuation
senses.definition: a professional report that states the value of an item for sale, insurance, or tax
senses.definitionCN: 为出售、保险或税务而出具的专业价值报告
senses.example: The insurer asked for an independent appraisal of the painting.
senses.exampleCN: 保险公司要求对这幅画做一次独立鉴定。
senses.why: Trade and insurance turned the general estimate into a signed expert report.
senses.whyCN: 交易与保险把一般性的估价固定成一份由专家签署的报告，于是 appraisal 有了专业鉴定这一文书义。

senses.title: A review of a plan or situation
senses.definition: a careful assessment of a plan, a policy, or a situation before a decision is made
senses.definitionCN: 在作决定之前对计划、政策或形势的仔细评估
senses.example: A calm appraisal of the risks came before the investment.
senses.exampleCN: 在投资之前，先对风险做了一次冷静的评估。
senses.why: The habit of weighing worth extends from objects to plans and situations that must be judged.
senses.whyCN: 给事物称量价值的习惯先从物品延伸到计划与形势，凡是需要判断的都可以来一次 appraisal。

senses.title: A critical reading of evidence
senses.definition: a careful, critical examination of research or evidence to judge how far it can be trusted
senses.definitionCN: 对研究或证据的仔细批判性审查，用以判断其可信程度
senses.example: The paper begins with a critical appraisal of earlier studies.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文开头对先前的研究做了一次严格评析。
senses.why: Academic method adds the note of criticism, so an appraisal can mean a disciplined reading that tests the worth of evidence.
senses.whyCN: 学术方法加上批判这一层，于是 appraisal 也能指那种检验证据价值的严格评读。

intro.en: Appraisal is the noun from appraise, which comes from Old French aprisier and Late Latin appretiare, to set a price on, from ad-, to, and pretium, price or value.
intro.cn: appraisal 是动词 appraise 加名词后缀 -al 构成的；appraise 经古法语 aprisier 上溯晚期拉丁语 appretiare（定价），由 ad-（向）加 pretium（价格、价值）构成。

items.en: Pretium means price or value, the noun that carries the whole family.
items.cn: pretium 意为价格或价值，是整个词族的核心名词。

items.en: Late Latin appretiare puts ad-, to, before pretium and means to set a price on something.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 appretiare 在 pretium 前加上 ad-（向），表示给某物定出价钱。

items.en: Old French aprisier keeps the verb with the sense of valuing or esteeming.
items.cn: 古法语 aprisier 保留了这个动词，义为估价、看重。

items.en: English borrows the verb as appraise, first naming the act of setting a price.
items.cn: 英语借入动词 appraise，最初指定价这一动作。

items.en: The noun appraisal is appraise plus -al; modern personnel work then gives it the sense of a formal staff review.
items.cn: 名词 appraisal 由 appraise 加 -al 构成；现代人事管理又给了它正式员工考核的含义。

note.en: Appraisal belongs to the Latin family of pretium, price, with appraise, appraiser, praise, and precious around it, and it sits near evaluation and assessment.
note.cn: appraisal 属于拉丁语「价格」词族，周围有 appraise、appraiser、praise、precious，并与 evaluation、assessment 意义相邻。

entries.definition: to set a value on something
entries.definitionCN: 给某物估价，是 appraisal 去掉名词后缀后得到的动词

entries.definition: a person who values property or goods
entries.definitionCN: 估价师；鉴定人，由 appraise 加施事后缀构成
赞扬；称赞，与 appraisal 同出拉丁语 pretium（价值），由「看重」引申为「称许」

entries.definition: a judgement of the value or quality of something
entries.definitionCN: 评估；评价，比 appraisal 更宽泛，不一定涉及价钱

entries.definition: a judgement about the quality or amount of something
entries.definitionCN: 评定；评估，常用于能力、税额与风险

entries.definition: an estimate of how much something is worth
entries.definitionCN: 估值；定价，多用于房产与公司资产

normalIntro.en: Appraisal is the act of putting a value on something, built on the Latin noun pretium, price.
normalIntro.cn: appraisal 是给某物定出价值的动作，建在拉丁语名词 pretium（价格）之上。

normal.en: The verb is appraise and the noun is appraisal: appraise plus -al.
normal.cn: 动词是 appraise，名词是 appraisal，即 appraise 加 -al 构成。

normal.en: Pretium, the Latin word for price, hides inside appraisal and precious.
normal.cn: 表示价格的拉丁词 pretium，就藏在 appraisal 与 precious 里面。

normal.en: A performance appraisal is the yearly review of an employee.
normal.cn: performance appraisal 就是对员工一年工作的考核。

normal.en: An appraisal interview is the meeting where the review is discussed.
normal.cn: appraisal interview 是讨论考核结果的面谈。

normal.en: Compare evaluation: evaluation is broader, while appraisal often adds the idea of a price or a formal rating.
normal.cn: 对比 evaluation：evaluation 更宽泛，appraisal 常带有定价或正式评分的意味。

abstract.en: Picture a supervisor ticking boxes on a score sheet.
abstract.cn: 想象主管在评分表上一格一格打勾。

abstract.en: Picture a small card with a price written on a house.
abstract.cn: 想象一张小卡片，上面写着一栋房子的价钱。

abstract.en: Picture a hand weighing an object before naming its worth.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手掂量物品，然后说出它值多少。

examples.en: Each new member of staff receives a written appraisal after three months.
examples.cn: 每位新员工在三个月后都会收到一份书面评估。

examples.en: The property appraisal came in below the asking price.
Regular appraisals help a team see where it can improve.
examples.cn: 定期的评估能帮助团队看到可以改进的地方。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿普瑞奏」——阿普把价钱报上一遍，瑞兹在旁边记下来，就是在做估价；谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 ad-（向）+ pretium（价格、价值）→ 晚期拉丁语 appretiare（给……定价）→ 古法语 aprisier（估价）→ 英语 appraise（评估）→ 加 -al 得 appraisal，核心义「给某物定出价值」。

sensesIntro.en: Appraisal keeps the Latin act of setting a price and extends it from property to the worth of work, plans, and evidence.
sensesIntro.cn: appraisal 保留拉丁语定价这一动作，并从房产扩展到工作表现、计划与证据的价值判断。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an object held in one hand while a price is written on its tag.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手托着物品，另一只手在价签上写下价钱。

branches.en: Rating an employee is the workplace sense of setting a value on work.
branches.cn: 给员工打分是把定价用在劳动上的职场义项。

branches.en: Valuing a building or a company is the plain property sense.
branches.cn: 给房产或公司估值是最朴素的财产义项。

branches.en: Any careful opinion of worth is the broad judgement sense.
branches.cn: 任何对价值的审慎看法都属于宽泛的判断义项。

branches.en: A signed expert report is the professional and insurance sense.
branches.cn: 由专家签署的报告构成专业鉴定与保险义项。

branches.en: Plans and research evidence are weighed in the review senses.
branches.cn: 计划与研究证据则在审议与评析这两个义项里被衡量。

intro.en: Appraisal is built from the Latin noun pretium, price or value: the prefix ad-, worn down to ap-, plus pretium gives appretiare, and English adds the noun suffix -al.
intro.cn: appraisal 建在拉丁语名词 pretium（价格、价值）之上：前缀 ad- 在 p 前同化为 ap-，与 pretium 合成 appretiare，英语再加名词后缀 -al。

latinIntro.en: Latin ad- means to or toward, and pretium means price; appretiare therefore means to set a price on something.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ad- 意为向、朝向，pretium 意为价格；两者合成的 appretiare 就是给某物定价。

items.example: The prefix ad- assimilates to ap- before a p.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ad- 在 p 前同化为 ap-。

items.example: Pretium is the value at the heart of the word.
items.exampleCN: pretium 是这个词核心处的价值。

items.example: Late Latin appretiare joins ad- and pretium.
items.exampleCN: 晚期拉丁语 appretiare 由 ad- 与 pretium 合成。

items.example: Old French aprisier carries the verb onward.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 aprisier 把这个动词继续传下去。

items.example: English appraise keeps the act of valuing.
items.exampleCN: 英语 appraise 保留了估价这一动作。

items.meaningCN: 由动词构成名词的后缀
items.example: The suffix -al turns appraise into appraisal.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -al 把 appraise 变成 appraisal。

items.meaning: a valuation or a formal review
items.example: Appraisal names both the price and the review.
items.exampleCN: appraisal 既指定出的价钱，也指正式的评估。

items.example: An appraiser signs the valuation report.
items.exampleCN: 估价师在估价报告上签字。

items.example: She looked appraisingly at the offer.
items.exampleCN: 她用审视的目光看了看这份报价。

definition_en: money paid back to someone, or to pay money back to someone
core_image: 一叠钞票沿着来时的路，退回付款人手里
scene: 顾客发现外套袖口有破洞，回到店里出示小票，店员把货款原样退回他的卡里。When the customer brought back the torn coat, the shop gave him a full refund.
sceneCN: 这里 refund 是「退款」（第 1 个义项：退回给付款人的那笔钱）；句意：顾客把破了的外套拿回店里时，店家给了他全额退款。

derivatives.zh: refund 加后缀 -able，义为「可退还的」
否定前缀 non- 加 refundable，义为「不可退还的」
refund 加 -ing 构成的名词，义为「退款」；在金融里也指债务的再融资

senses.title: Money paid back
senses.definition: money that is given back to a customer who has paid for goods or a service
senses.definitionCN: 退还给已付款顾客的那笔钱
senses.example: She kept the receipt in case she needed a refund.
senses.exampleCN: 她留着收据，以备需要退款。
senses.why: Refund begins as a pouring back: the Latin verb means to pour back, and the first English sense is the money that flows back to the payer.
senses.whyCN: refund 最初是「倒回去」：拉丁语动词意为把东西倒回原处，所以最早的英语义项就是流回付款人手里的那笔钱。

senses.title: To give money back
senses.definition: to return money to someone who has paid for something
senses.definitionCN: 把钱退还给为某物付过款的人
senses.example: The airline refunded the ticket price after the flight was cancelled.
senses.exampleCN: 航班取消后，航空公司退还了机票款。
senses.why: The verb keeps the physical image of pouring the money back along the path it came by.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留了把钱沿原路倒回这一具体意象。

senses.title: A tax refund
senses.definition: money that a tax office returns when someone has paid more tax than is owed
senses.definitionCN: 税务机关在纳税人多缴税款后退回的钱
senses.example: He used his tax refund to pay off the credit card.
senses.exampleCN: 他用退税款还清了信用卡。
senses.why: Modern tax systems reuse the pouring-back image for money the state returns.
senses.whyCN: 现代税制沿用了倒回这一意象，用来指国家退回的钱。

senses.title: A deposit returned
senses.definition: money given back when a deposit is released or a service has not been used
senses.definitionCN: 押金退还或服务未使用时退回的钱
senses.example: The landlord agreed to a refund of the cleaning deposit.
senses.exampleCN: 房东同意退还清洁押金。
senses.why: Any sum held in advance can flow back, so deposits and unused fees join the refund family.
senses.whyCN: 任何预先收下的款项都可能倒流回来，于是押金与未使用的费用也进入了 refund 的义场。

senses.title: To reimburse an expense
senses.definition: to pay back money that someone has already spent on behalf of another party
senses.definitionCN: 把某人替他人垫付的钱还给他
senses.example: The company will refund your travel costs within ten days.
senses.exampleCN: 公司会在十天内退还你的差旅费用。
senses.why: Business expense claims extend the verb from a purchase to any cost paid out for another party.
senses.whyCN: 商务报销把动词从一笔购物扩展到任何替他人垫付的费用。

intro.en: Refund comes from Latin refundere, to pour back or give back, from re-, back, and fundere, to pour; the noun refund, the sum returned, grew out of the verb in English.
intro.cn: refund 来自拉丁语 refundere（倒回、归还），由 re-（回）加 fundere（倒、倾注）构成；表示退款的名词义则是在英语里从动词长出来的。

items.en: Fundere means to pour, and English fusion comes from the same verb.
items.cn: fundere 意为倒、倾注，英语 fusion 也出自同一个动词。

items.en: Re- means back, so refundere is to pour back, hence to give back what was received.
items.cn: re- 表示回，所以 refundere 就是倒回去，引申为把收下的东西归还。

items.en: Old French refunder carries the giving-back verb into French.
items.cn: 古法语 refunder 把这个表示归还的动词带进法语。

items.en: English refund first appears as a verb meaning to give back money or restore something taken.
items.cn: 英语 refund 最初是动词，意为退还钱款或归还原物。

items.en: The noun refund settles into shop, ticket, and tax use, naming the sum that comes back.
items.cn: 名词 refund 在商店、票务与税务场景里固定下来，专指退回的那笔钱。

note.en: Refund belongs to the Latin pouring family of fundere and refundere, with refundable and refunding beside it, and it sits near rebate, reimbursement, and repayment.
note.cn: refund 属于拉丁语「倒、倾注」词族，旁边有 refundable 与 refunding，并与 rebate、reimbursement、repayment 意义相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 可退还的，由 refund 加 -able 构成

entries.definition: the act of paying money back
entries.definitionCN: 退款行为，也可指债务再融资

entries.definition: a sum of money set aside for a purpose
entries.definitionCN: 基金；资金，只是拼写相近，词源不同：fund 出自拉丁语 fundus（底部、地产）

entries.definition: a partial return of money paid, often as a discount
entries.definitionCN: 回扣；部分退款，通常是价格优惠的一部分

entries.definition: money paid back for costs someone has already met
entries.definitionCN: 报销款，指补偿他人已垫付的费用

entries.definition: money paid back against a loan or a debt
entries.definitionCN: 还款，多指偿还借款或债务

normalIntro.en: Refund joins re-, back, to the Latin verb fundere, to pour, so the word pictures money poured back to its owner.
normalIntro.cn: refund 由 re-（回）加拉丁语动词 fundere（倒、倾注）构成，画面就是把钱倒回主人手里。

normal.en: Re- means back and fundere means to pour: refund is to pour back.
normal.cn: re- 表示回，fundere 表示倒，refund 就是把东西倒回去。

normal.en: The verb refund is stressed on the second syllable, the noun on the first.
normal.cn: 动词 refund 重音在后，名词 refund 重音在前。

normal.en: A full refund returns every penny the customer paid.
normal.cn: full refund 是把顾客付的每一分钱都退回去。

normal.en: A tax refund comes from the tax office, not from a shop.
normal.cn: tax refund 来自税务部门，而不是商店。

normal.en: Refundable means the money can be returned; non-refundable means it cannot.
normal.cn: refundable 表示钱可以退，non-refundable 表示不能退。

abstract.en: Picture a shop assistant counting notes back into the hand of the customer.
abstract.cn: 想象店员把钞票数回顾客手里。

abstract.en: Picture money sliding back along the same path it came by.
abstract.cn: 想象钱沿着来时的路滑回去。

abstract.en: Picture a tax form with a small sum circled for return.
abstract.cn: 想象一张税表，上面圈出一小笔要退回的钱。

examples.en: The shop offered a refund without asking for a reason.
examples.cn: 商店没问原因就给了退款。

examples.en: He refunded the deposit two days after the inspection.
examples.cn: 他在检查后两天退还了押金。

examples.en: Only part of the fee was refunded to the students.
examples.cn: 只把一部分费用退还给了学生。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞返」——钱从柜台那头返回到你手上，就是退款；谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回、向后）+ fundere（倒、倾注）→ 拉丁语 refundere（倒回；归还）→ 古法语 refunder → 英语 refund，核心义「把钱倒回付款人手里」。另有同形词由 re- 加 fund（资金）构成，义为「重新融资」，与本词无关。

sensesIntro.en: Refund keeps the Latin image of pouring money back: it names the sum returned, the act of returning it, and the tax, deposit, and expense sums that flow back.
sensesIntro.cn: refund 保留拉丁语把钱倒回去的意象：既指退回的那笔钱，也指退钱这个动作，还延伸到退税款、押金退款与报销款。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of notes handed back to the person who paid.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠钞票被交回给当初付款的人。

branches.en: The sum that comes back is the everyday noun sense.
branches.cn: 退回来的那笔钱是最日常的名词义项。

branches.en: The act of handing the money back is the verb sense.
branches.cn: 把钱交回去这个动作是动词义项。

branches.en: Tax offices return overpaid tax with the same image.
branches.cn: 税务机关用同一意象退回多缴的税。

branches.en: Deposits and unused fees flow back as well.
branches.cn: 押金与未使用的费用同样会倒流回来。

branches.en: Reimbursing a cost extends the verb to money spent for another party.
branches.cn: 报销把动词扩展到替他人垫付的费用。

intro.en: Refund is built on the Latin verb fundere, to pour, with the prefix re-, back: refundere means to pour back, and English later makes the noun refund from it.
intro.cn: refund 建在拉丁语动词 fundere（倒、倾注）之上，加上前缀 re-（回），refundere 即倒回去；英语后来又由它造出名词 refund。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means back and fundere means to pour, so refundere means to pour back and, in use, to give back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 re- 意为回，fundere 意为倒，所以 refundere 意为倒回去，实际使用时就是归还。

items.example: The prefix re- turns pouring into pouring back.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 把倒变成了倒回去。
refundere 由 re- 与 fundere 合成。

items.example: Old French refunder passes the verb to English.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 refunder 把这个动词传给英语。

items.example: English refund keeps the act of giving back.
items.exampleCN: 英语 refund 保留了归还这一动作。

items.example: The noun refund names the sum returned.
items.exampleCN: 名词 refund 指退回的那笔钱。

items.example: Refundable describes a fare that can be returned.
items.exampleCN: refundable 描述可以退的票款。
